_about.what: REAL response from the BLS Public Data API v1 (no key): OEWS wages for Electricians (47-2111), May 2025 survey: hourly mean (03), hourly median (08) and annual mean (04) for Nevada, Reno, Las Vegas, Carson City, California, Sacramento, the nation and Balance of Nevada, plus national employment (01). Sent with no year range, so BLS added "No Data Available" messages for 2023 and 2024.
